mav.f: (Australia, television, uncountable) Initialism of mature adult audience (“Strong Violence”).

s.g: (India) A form of smokeless tobacco combined with with betel nut, lime, etc.
(chiefly US) An expert in a given field; also, a person who is interested in and knowledgeable about a particular activity or thing; an aficionado.
Showing independence in thoughts or actions.
s.x: He made a maverick decision.  She is such a maverick person.

s.g: (by extension) One who is unconventional or does not abide by rules.
s.x: Among historians he was a maverick because of his belief that history is meaningless.

s.g: (by extension) One who creates or uses controversial or unconventional ideas or practices.
(military) A person in the military who became an officer by going to college while on active duty as an enlisted person.
(US) To take an unbranded range animal.
(by extension) To seize without a legal claim.
A member of one of the sports teams with a mascot called Maverick.
Someone who attends, or has attended in the past, one of these schools, especially one involved in the sports teams.
